meta.homeTitle: Nile cruises, explained before you sail
meta.homeDescription: How a sailing dahabiya, a paddle steamer and a motor cruise ship differ on board, and why one five-star cabin costs ten times another.

home.title: Nile cruises, explained before you sail
home.lead: We are building a guide to how Nile vessels differ on board and why their prices range so widely. The first pages are on their way.

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

error.title: Something went wrong on our side
error.body: Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact us and we will look into it.

legal.draftBanner: Draft, under review. This text is not final and is not yet in force.

cruiseSearch.agesRequired: Choose each child's age: children's prices depend on it.

cabinPicker.signInForPrices: Sign in to see prices and dates for every cabin.

bookingSummary.label: Booking summary
bookingSummary.gratuity: Crew gratuities, paid on board at check-out
bookingSummary.gratuityDetail: {rate} × {guests} guests × {nights} nights · not included in the total

state.errorBody: Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact us.
state.deniedBody: Sign in with an account that has access to see this.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lede: Sign in to see prices for every cabin and date, send requests and follow your bookings.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lede: With an account you see every cabin price, ask operators for offers and keep your bookings in one place.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with a letter and a number.
signUp.sentBody: If this address can be used, we have sent a link to confirm it. The link works once, for one hour.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.lede: Press the button to confirm. We ask for a press, not just the link, so email scanners can't use up your link.
verify.failedTitle: This link has expired or was already used
verify.failedBody: Links work once, for one hour. Ask for a new one below.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lede: Enter the email of your account and we will send a link to choose a new password.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign‑in
twoStep.lede: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code for Nilecruz.
twoStep.lost: Lost your authenticator? Contact us and we will check it is you before we reset it.

security.title: Account security
security.lede: Your sign-in details, your two-step sign-in and the devices you are signed in on.
security.emailNote: We send a link to both addresses. The change happens when both are confirmed.
security.twoStepOn: On. Each sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
security.twoStepOff: Off. Turn it on so a stolen password is not enough to get in.
security.twoStepAdmin: Required for Nilecruz admins. Set it up to use the admin workspace.
security.twoStepScan: Scan this code with an authenticator app, or type the key into it. Then enter the six-digit code it shows.
security.twoStepQr: QR code for your authenticator app
security.devicesBody: Sign out on every phone and computer, including this one.
security.emailsNote: We always email you about bookings, payments, payment deadlines and cancellations. You can turn off the others: updated offers and progress on booking requests.
security.optionalEmails: Also email me about updated offers and booking request progress

notices.signedOutEverywhere: You have been signed out on every device.
notices.setupTwoStep: Admins need two-step sign-in. Set it up below to continue.
notices.emailHalfConfirmed: One address is confirmed. Open the link we sent to the other address to finish the change.

messages.badCredentials: That email and password don't match an account. Check both and try again.
messages.notConfirmed: Confirm your email first. We can send the link again.
messages.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
messages.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
messages.checkEmail: If this address can be used, a link is on its way. It works once, for one hour.
messages.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
messages.codeWrong: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds: try the current one.
messages.emailChangeSent: We have sent a link to your old and your new address. Confirm both to finish.
messages.adminNeedsTwoStep: Admins can't turn off two-step sign-in.
messages.resetLinkNeeded: For your safety, open a new password link from your email first.

errors.emailFormat: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.passwordLetterDigit: Use at least one letter and one number.
errors.passwordReuse: Choose a password you haven't used here.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the six digits from your authenticator app.

apply.title: Apply as an operator
apply.lede: Run a Nile cruise company? Apply here. Nilecruz checks every company before it can sell through the marketplace; we email you when the check is done.
apply.note: After approval you can invite your team and submit your vessels.
apply.already: You already have an application waiting. You can follow it in your dashboard.
apply.signedOutPrompt: Sign in or create an account first, then apply.

errors.websiteFormat: Use a full address starting with https://.

apply.link: Run a cruise company? Apply as an operator

applyPartner.title: Apply as a travel partner
applyPartner.lede: A travel agency or tour operator booking Nile cruises for clients? Apply for trade access. Nilecruz checks every agency first; we email you when the check is done.
applyPartner.registrationHint: For example a Ministry of Tourism licence or an IATA number.
applyPartner.note: After approval you can invite your reservations and finance colleagues and see trade rates.
applyPartner.already: You already have an application waiting. You can follow it in your dashboard.

errors.required: This is needed to check your agency.
errors.websiteFormat: Use a full address starting with https://.

applyPartner.link: A travel agency? Apply for trade access
